segments.name: Intellectual Property
segments.description: Licenses processor architecture and designs to semiconductor and systems companies, and earns royalties on chips that incorporate its technology.
segments.evidence: risks related to our development of production silicon products, such as the Arm AGI CPU, compute subsystems ("CSS"), chiplets, complete chip solutions, and other more integrated compute products;

revenueModel.text: Customers pay license fees and royalties to use Arm processor architecture, processor products and related technology.
revenueModel.evidence: Customers may decide to license our architecture and develop their own processors based on our architecture, rather than utilize our processor products pursuant to an implementation license.
